visual.description: Primary white background used for content sections, navigation, and footer areas.
Near-black used for logo, navigation links, section headings, and product names.
Pure black used for body copy, prices, footer links, and form text.
The navigation bar has a white/light background at top of page with dark text.
White navigation background in the top-of-page state.
Dark text for navigation links in the top-of-page state.
Navigation remains white after scroll, consistent with top state.
Navigation text remains dark after scroll.
Very dark navy/near-black that dominates the hero video background with dramatic moody lighting.
Deep cobalt blue visible in garments within the hero, contributing to the brand's signature color presence.
Pure black fill used for the primary 'View All' CTA button in the shop section.
White surface used for product card backgrounds and content section backgrounds.
Warm light grey used for subtle borders on ghost buttons and form input underlines.
Very light grey used as product image backgrounds for the shop grid.
Medium grey used for dates and secondary metadata in the editorial grid.
Bright indigo/purple from the accessibility widget button — not part of the brand design system.
